title: Choose Subham's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Laser-cut Invitation. Keep it, take my pick, or re-roll.

options.label: Laser-cut Invitation
options.lineage: Indian wedding & function invitation cards: layered laser-cut jaali, gold foil, peacock and rani-pink board
options.thesis: Every plan opens like the invitation card a family sends: layered, foil-edged, one card per function. The category's cream-and-serif planner page is refused.
options.viewport: A Three.js invitation card floats open at the centre of a peacock-green field, its laser-cut jaali layers parting to reveal the inner sheet, which IS the working 'describe your celebration' form. Gold-foil function tabs (Haldi · Mehendi · Sangeet · Muhurtham · Reception) fan out from its edge. Petals drift. Nav sits on the outer card's border.
options.risk: Gold foil plus 3D can tip into wedding-only kitsch; birthdays and community events must get their own card colours, and foil has to stay on edges, never on text fields.

raised.raise: Foil is confined to card edges and hairline rules; every text field stays calm and achromatic.
State is light: the active card catches a foil highlight, inactive function cards lie flat.
One object owns the first viewport: the single invitation, never a hero plus card row.

options.label: Diwali Serial Lights
options.lineage: strings of serial bulbs draped over Indian homes and pandals at festival time
options.thesis: The plan as a facade strung with lights: each function is a strand that lights up as its tasks get done.
options.viewport: A Three.js night facade draped with swaying bulb strands; the strands spell the event's functions, and the describe-your-celebration input sits on a lit doorway at the centre.
options.risk: Familiar: dark ground with glowing accents is where many festive pages land, and it skews towards Diwali over weddings.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.case: Fuses poorly: families and committees don't identify with atmospheric optics; the plan's functions get lost in white space.
options.kept: Colour confined to edges; text fields stay calm.

options.label: Akari Light Sculpture
options.case: Fuses partly: the 'state as light' idea suits celebration, but the Japanese material world loses Indian audience identification.
options.kept: State is light: active cards glow, inactive ones lie flat.

options.label: Fletcher Wit Poster
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful but generic; nothing reads as an Indian celebration.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean event-planning SaaS page: white ground, one brand colour, product screenshots, feature grid.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and input on the left, a dashboard screenshot on the right, three feature cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any planner; little celebration.
